answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The echo lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the meadow is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
